issues.issue: The Cemetery department's function lines (detail[38], [46], [53], [62], [70], [78], [86], [94]) use health/welfare. On the governmental funds statement (p5) the Cemetery department's non-capital spending, 103,475, makes up the General Fund's 'Public works' line (103,473). So the detail function split doesn't tie to the statement's function lines. The category list does put cemetery under health/welfare, so this is a judgment call.
Includes 103,473 of General Fund cemetery spending (see Cemetery department, p17) along with the Street Fund's 477,909. Mapping it all to streets/highways is defensible but mixes in cemetery.

The governmental funds statement (p5, General Fund column) shows this as Property 1,191,114 + Motor vehicle 82,388. As recorded, 82,388 of motor vehicle tax sits under property tax in the detail. The extractor noted this; a split with split_from could be justified.
Fire department charges are probably ambulance/rescue fees or rural fire contracts. Category is a judgment call.
'Transportation' for park, police, fire and cemetery departments (detail[75]-[78]) may be mostly vehicle fuel or vehicle costs (fuel) rather than travel. Judgment call.
The 'Salaries and benefits' lines (detail[32]-[38]) combine wages and benefits. Recorded as salaries and wages; the extractor noted this.

General Fund department 'Capital outlay' lines (detail[100]-[106]) are put under equipment purchases with no object breakdown on the page. The extractor's notes call this a guess; 'not itemized' or a review flag would also fit.

Business-type sales tax 425,417 (Bond-Enterprise Fund) is exactly the same as the General Fund's sales tax, 425,417 (p5, p12). The government-wide statement (p3) prints both, but a person should confirm this isn't the same sales tax recorded twice (governmental and business-type).
Street Fund intergovernmental revenue is probably mostly highway allocation. Already marked review.

beginning_cash and ending_cash are the governmental fund balances (modified cash basis, net of interfund due to/from). The governmental funds balance sheet (p4) shows cash, CDs and county treasurer cash of 1,896,471. This is the extractor's stated assumption.
